Population increased in Sefton

The estimated population of Sefton in 2024 was 286,281 usual residents, a rise of 0.9% since 2023.

This meant that Sefton's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Sefton increased by 2.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Sefton was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Sefton

The average (median) age fell to 45.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Sefton has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Sefton is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Sefton's population of 286,281 usual residents was made up of:

  • 48,352 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.9%)
  • 170,066 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.4%)
  • 67,863 people aged 65 years and over, (23.7%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Sefton has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (23.7% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Sefton, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Sefton
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Sefton, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 1,084 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 2,398 births and 3,482 deaths in Sefton.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 2,370 (0.8%). There were 13,047 people entering the area and 10,677 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Sefton's population of 1,236 (0.4%) as a result of 2,116 people entering the area and 880 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Sefton was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Sefton in mid-2023 is 283,720.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 678 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 297 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 975 people.
